commitments.detail: Provide written notice to all employees regarding the deployment of the voice-authentication access system, including details on consent requirements, data handling practices, and union notification.
Require opt-in consent from employees for the collection and processing of their voice recordings.
Prohibit monitoring of off-hours voice recordings and ensure compliance through regular audits.
Implement a policy for deleting voice recordings after 90 days of inactivity.
Provide notice to all employees regarding the voice-authentication system, including how their voice data will be used, stored, and deleted.
Train HR staff on handling employee consent for voice data collection and processing.
Prohibit monitoring of off-hours voice data and ensure strict adherence to this policy.
Implement a policy requiring deletion of voiceprints within 90 days of their last use.
Notify the union representative of the voice-authentication system and provide them with 30 days to review and raise concerns.
Provide written notice to all covered workers at least 30 days prior to deployment.
Vendor must obtain opt-in consent from each worker before collecting and processing their voice recordings.
Monitoring of voice recordings is prohibited during non-working hours.
Voiceprints must be deleted after 90 days of last use.
Voice recordings may only be used for account authentication purposes and not for any secondary uses.
Provide notice to all employees regarding the voice-authentication system, including details on data collection, storage, and deletion policies.
Train HR staff on handling employee inquiries and concerns related to the voice-authentication system.
Develop a policy prohibiting monitoring of off-hours voice recordings.
Implement a policy requiring voiceprints to be deleted after 90 days of inactivity.
